segments.en: Okay, tell me.
Where are you from?
I am from Ernakulam.
What do you do?
I work at a car showroom.
Is there no work there?
I had some work, so I am leaving. I will be there by 10 o'clock.
Where are you calling from?
I am from Guruvayur.
What do you do?
I am a Thirumeni (priest).
Are you a temple priest?
Can you see me?
Are you a fortune teller?
No, no, no. Nothing like that. I don't do any fortune telling.
What is your name?
My name is Sharanya.
Where is your place?
Pathanamthitta.
I work in Ernakulam.
Where do you stay?
Here in Ernakulam.
Is it a hostel?
Where do you stay? Is it a hostel?
No, it is an apartment.
Which temple is Shanthi?
There is no temple now. I am old, so I don't have any health issues.
I go occasionally if there is any program.
Oh, so do you know fortune telling?
No, no, no.
Is fortune telling your job?
There is plenty of fortune telling.
Is it? Some people say... can I ask you a question?
Is this Koodu-bathram (a type of ritual) real or fake?
I don't know. I don't know about that. I don't know anything about Koodu-bathram or anything.
I don't know anything about that.
That is not what I asked. My brother... I have a brother, my elder brother.
He got married, but it is not a happy marriage.
It is not Koodu-bathram, it is Koodu-othram.
Ah, that is it, that is it.
That girl's family... I and my mother...
Some people have experience, some don't. It might happen.
My brother's life is ruined.
Just pray to God. Pray to God, that is all you can do.
But there is another thing. My brother's job is here in Hyderabad.
He is set up with a girl there, and they have a child there.
The wife, my sister-in-law, is at Hidumbi's house.
She went there and got settled, right?
That girl is not needed, the brother is not needed. They are just standing there legally.
So what should we do?
What can you do? Pray to God, pray well, chant the name every day. Do that.
Tell your brother and tell your family members. That is the main thing.
My brother doesn't want that girl.
If he doesn't want her, pray to get rid of her. Pray that it gets sorted out.
But Thirumeni, she won't leave. She wants money.
She is asking for a huge amount.
We can't fix it. We have to pray to God to solve it.
I am a Hindu. Which is the best God in Hinduism?
There is nothing like that. All Gods are good. I won't say one God is good and another is bad. All Gods are good. You just need faith in God.
But I have only one God. When I look, there is only one God, and that is a human.
Then you should follow your faith. Don't look at other superstitions.
No, God doesn't come directly in front of us. He comes in the form of humans.
That is all.
God will never come directly in front of us. So, we are humans... now, I am seeing Thirumeni. I am seeing Thirumeni randomly.
So God... I told you about my brother's matters. Can I ask you one thing?
That relationship should end. The second relationship is a good one, my brother is happy.
There is no one at home, but he is very happy when I call him.
But in the first relationship, he has a daughter.
In the second relationship, he has a son.
We don't have any opinion on that. If it is good, let it happen. That is all I have to say.
Don't go and waste money on fortune tellers.
I and my mother wasted money. Do you know Hari Pathanapuram? He is very famous.
I don't know, I don't know.
You don't know? You should know, Thirumeni.
No, I don't know. He did a lot of things. What about the Plathi people?
I don't know. I don't follow all that.
Is that so? Okay.
My time is almost up, and my money is running out.
Okay, okay.
Are you on WhatsApp?
Yes, I have WhatsApp.
